title: Conformal Prediction for Distribution-Free Monitor Alarm Thresholds

original_idea.body:
# Conformal Prediction for Distribution-Free Monitor Alarm Thresholds

**Problem:** Monitor thresholds are hand-tuned with no false-alarm guarantee and break under distribution shift.

**Direction:** Import conformal prediction to set thresholds with a distribution-free FPR guarantee. Calibrate on held-out benign trajectories, evaluate realized FPR/miss rates on test trajectories, and stress-test under induced benign covariate shift.

**Why it matters:** Replaces arbitrary thresholds with a calibrated, auditable false-alarm guarantee. Lightweight, training-free, addresses the fuzzy threshold-setting problem.

**Relevant context:** Conformal process monitoring (arXiv:2512.23602); WATCH (arXiv:2505.04608).

novelty.reasoning: Conformal prediction mature; control-monitor threshold application plausibly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Conformal methods mature; control-specific use plausibly open.
